description: Agents that ship as JetBrains plugins, beside the two 80-linux-jetbrains proves.
why: The plugin directory is the only witness on this host for each agent -- no npm Copilot, no VS Code, no Gemini CLI -- so removing a value turns must_find red. gemini-cli is forbidden because Gemini Code Assist's directory is just `gemini`, and a separate Google product must not be read from it. cline and continue are forbidden because 80 installs those into the same kind of directory and none is installed here.
known_gaps: Unpacked from the Marketplace zip, not installed by an IDE, as in 80: the IDE's own install and update paths are untested.
Amazon Q's plugin needs AWS Core (aws.toolkit.core) to load in an IDE. It is not installed, because only the directory is under test.
